convert_luke_checkpoint: convert a LUKE original PyTorch checkpoint to HuggingFace LukeModel format with entity-aware attention
load_entity_vocab: load an entity vocabulary from a TSV file into a dictionary mapping entity titles to indices
run_convert_luke_cli: run the LUKE checkpoint conversion CLI with checkpoint, metadata, entity vocab, and output paths
test_convert_luke_checkpoint: test the LUKE checkpoint conversion verifies hidden state shapes and values match expected tensors
review_load_entity_vocab: review the entity vocab loader that parses TSV lines into a title-to-index mapping
